instruction: Can you set VLC to start minimized? I want it to launch in the system tray instead of showing the window.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
